title: split_h5mu
description: Split the samples of a single modality from a .h5mu (multimodal) sample into seperate .h5mu files based on the values of an .obs column of this modality.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

obs_feature.description: The .obs column to split the mudata on.

drop_obs_nan.description: Whether to drop all .obs columns that contain only nan values after splitting.

ensure_unique_filenames.description: Append number suffixes to ensure unique filenames after sanitizing obs feature values.

output.description: Output directory containing multiple h5mu files.
output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `/path/to/output`

output_files.description: A csv containing the base filename and obs feature by which it was split.
output_files.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `sample_files.csv`

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
